test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The ______ of the crime scene made it difficult for investigators to gather evidence.
solution:
The correct answer is **"site."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Site"** means the location where something happened, which is the most appropriate word to use in the given sentence. (वह स्‍थान जहाँ कोई इमारत खड़ी थी, है या होगी; भवन स्‍थल)

 
 
• **Example**:* I visited the **site**__ yesterday.*
 
 
 
• The sentence says that it was challenging for detectives to collect evidence at the crime location.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The __**site**__ of the crime scene made it difficult for investigators to gather evidence.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Cite" **means** **to mention something or use somebody’s exact words as an example to support, or as proof of, what you are saying. (उदाहरण या प्रमाणस्‍वरूप किसी बात का उल्‍लेख करना या किसी व्‍यक्ति के मूल शब्‍द उद्धृत करना)
 
• **"Set" **can be used in various contexts such as arranging objects, fixing a time or place, or establishing a precedent. (वस्तुओं को व्यवस्थित करना, समय या स्थान तय करना, या एक मिसाल कायम करना)
 
• **"Sleight" **means the use of dexterity or cunning, especially so as to deceive. (निपुणता या धूर्तता का प्रयोग, विशेषकर धोखा देना)

30:Tb17,

The correct answer is **"honourable."**
